test_result_method: Last result per (classname, name) across the listed runs: 340 cases passed on the exact Linux v2 candidate, with 36 additional QQ compatibility cases passed locally.
scope: Legacy QQ snapshot path and shared Runtime; existing production/research execution routes retained.
verified_behaviors: Blocked heartbeat thread scan does not prevent foreground QQ completion.
Heartbeat scheduler continues during a blocked foreground QQ model.
Appraisal and guidance model waits do not lock foreground affect reads, delivery or checkpoint.
Independent thread lanes preserve ContextVars; cancelled callers retain physical worker ownership.
Emotion commits preserve concurrent delivery and newer foreground cursor.
Both JSON and SQLite background emotion persistence exclude uncommitted foreground revision and session.
Heartbeat coalesces pending ticks, retains paused work, restarts after drained close.
Homeostasis writes serialize; late QQ results are fenced after pause.
Shutdown is bounded and retains exclusive state ownership until physical work settles.
QQ frozen Homeostasis read revision remains bound while heartbeat advances during web preparation or affect reads; replay preserves that binding and mutations retain the current revision.
limits: Deployed and service health verified; no controlled post-change QQ reply latency sample.
Queues and blocking threads are independent, but CPU, network, model capacity and durable state remain shared.
Shared-state mutations and durable commits retain short locks.
Synchronous controller ownership and SQLite mutation remain on the owner loop; read scans use thread-owned connections.
History import, web selection, model input preparation and QQ reply coalescing are outside this implementation.
